    {"field": "Polymer system Notes", "value": "PEO-LiAsF6 system forms intermediate compounds P(EO6LiAsF6) and P(EO3LiAsF6). Eutectic temperature ~55°C. Electrolytes with salt content > PEO5LiAsF6 are thermally unstable (blackening, conductivity increase >90°C)."},
    {"field": "Polymer family", "value": "ether"},
    {"field": "chain architecture", "value": "linear"},
    {"field": "Solvent used", "value": "acetonitrile"},
    {"field": "drying temp", "value": "95-100"},
    {"field": "drying time (h)", "value": "48"},
    {"field": "drying vacuum", "value": "yes"},
    {"field": "Notes", "value": "PEO high molecular weight (900 K). Salt LiAsF6 recrystallized in acetonitrile. Intermediate compound stoichiometry P(EO3LiAsF6) confirmed by WAXS and DSC. Phase diagram shows eutectic between PEO and P(EO6LiAsF6)."},
    {"field": "Reference", "value": "C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)."},
    {"field": "DOI", "value": "10.1149/1.2096676"}
  ],
